label: PF Backlog 530
title: Backlog batch grooming: groom-all + review + approve-all (CLI + API) with batched LLM (--batch N)
body:
Bulk grooming is currently one item per invocation, and each AI groom makes TWO agent runs (analysis via grooming._run_ai + advisory context_review), so grooming 33 open items means ~66 agent runs, run sequentially at the CLI. Related/completed prior work: BI-PF-0363 (PFSSOT-P2 AI+user grooming), BI-PF-0432 (dedup marking + bulk sweep), BI-PF-0435 (AI consolidation), BI-PF-0665 (AI context review). None provide a batch groom/approve workflow.

Add a batch grooming workflow: groom-all (groom every open item), review (one view of results), approve-all (approve clean items in bulk). Reduce LLM work by batching 2-3 items per agent run and emitting BOTH the analysis proposal and the context_review per item in one pass, with per-item deterministic fallback.

brief.problem: Grooming/approving the open backlog is one item at a time and doubles agent runs per item (analysis + context_review); ~66 runs for 33 items.
brief.what_adds: Bulk groom-all / review / approve-all verbs with batched LLM passes.

objective: Make bulk backlog grooming practical: groom all open items in batched LLM passes, review the results in one view, then approve clean items in bulk.
acceptance_criteria: pf backlog groom-all [--no-ai] [--batch N] [--limit N] [--depth deep|standard] [--dry] grooms all open items (incl. EPICs), skips IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETE, paced via core/capacity; default AI, batch N=3.
pf backlog review prints id/title/analysis.status/confidence/dup+consolidation flags/context_review verdict.
pf backlog approve-all [--ids ...] [--force] [--dry] approves only CLEAN IN_PROGRESS items; lists flagged items; --force overrides; --ids subsets.

Batched LLM: one agent run per N items returns per-item {analysis, context_review}; any missing/garbled item falls back to per-item deterministic analysis (never blocks); item stays IN_PROGRESS until decided.
API parity: POST /backlog/groom (batch) and POST /backlog/groom/approve (batch) mirror CLI; operator-gated.
Docs: pf.md SSOT (.opencode/command_global/pf.md) + installed copy stay byte-identical (pf_surface_check).
in_scope: batched LLM (2-3 items/pass) emitting analysis + context_review per item
out_of_scope: new store or second writer (backlog stays the single writer)
approach: Backlog batch grooming: groom-all + review + approve-all (CLI + API) with batched LLM (--batch N)
verification: Objective achieved: Backlog batch grooming: groom-all + review + approve-all (CLI + API) with batched LLM (--batch N)

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/context_review.py, core/cross_review.py

dashboard_impact.reason: CLI + API verb; no dashboard surface required
